title: Bundle v1
description: K-01, the step-graph bundle format, v1 (drafted by T-008, frozen by T-010; contracts/bundle/README.md holds the freeze record). A bundle is 'the step graph, prompts, model ids and policy one turn ran on, stored under one id' (arch 01 line 87; ops/plan/02-contracts.md K-01). Layout (Q-34 default): one manifest, one master graph per flow and one compiled overlay per trade, each stored as its own KV value under the bundle id (arch 10 line 536). The root of this schema is the whole bundle as one document, the form the compiler writes before it splits it into KV values and the form sample bundles take; $defs.manifest, $defs.flowGraph and $defs.tradeOverlay are the three kinds of KV value. Field names copied from the master keep the master's spelling (SPEC-master 4; overlay-core.js), so parity runs against the same functions (Q-35).

flows.description: The master graph of each flow in the bundle, by flow letter (02-contracts K-01 'The master graph, per flow'; SPEC-master 1: flow A, the customer comes to the business; flow B, the business goes to the customer). A sample bundle may hold one flow (bundle v0: S1-01 and S1-02 in flow A, D-007).

trades.description: One compiled overlay per trade, by trade id (Q-34 default; MC 1: 'The 243 trades', engine/work/prof/<id>.json). A sample bundle may hold one trade or none.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters (Q-36: fixture set v1 is a sha256 manifest; this contract hashes every input and value the same way).

flowLetter.title: FlowLetter
flowLetter.description: A flow: A, the customer comes to the business; B, the business goes to the customer (SPEC-master 1).

stepId.title: StepId
stepId.description: A step id: S (shared), A or B, the section number 1 to 13, a dash and two or three digits (SPEC-master 4: 'S1-01, A4-07, B8-15'; B4-115 has three). A trade's own step puts x before the digits (SPEC-prof 3: 'A4-x01, B8-x03').

lineId.title: LineId
lineId.description: A line of engine/design/LINES.md that a step covers, such as 4.6 (SPEC-master 4, 'line').

tradeId.title: TradeId
tradeId.description: A trade's id, the base name of its file engine/work/prof/<id>.json, such as plumber or property-manager (SPEC-prof 3, 'id'; MC 1).

lane.title: Lane
lane.description: Who acts or is told: owner (the owner or office manager), san (Rosie), staff, cust (the customer), agent (the customer's own AI), pay (Stripe), out (an outside service), other (anyone else) (SPEC-master 4 'who / to'; MC R1: san is Rosie and agent is the customer's own AI).

via.title: Via
via.description: How a step happens: chat (in the customer's AI chat), msg (texts), portal, page (a secure page), sync (system to system), auto (Rosie, automatic), visit (in person), call (phone), email (SPEC-master 4 'via').

name.title: Name
name.description: A switch, fact, slot group or booking value name: lowercase letters and digits (SPEC-master 5b: 'lowercase letters and digits'; lib.js parsePath, CORE.NAME).

price.title: PriceChoice
price.description: The price choice of a money path: list (from the price list), photos (quoted from photos first), visit (quoted at the visit) (SPEC-master 5; master-A.json and master-B.json money.dims.price).

before.title: BeforeChoice
before.description: What is taken before the visit: none, card (a card saved), deposit, full. No hold (SPEC-master D66 amendments, #3: header.json 'ways' lists the four).

after.title: AfterChoice
after.description: What is paid after: none, counter (flow A only), bill, card (the saved card charged at DONE), own (flow B only) (SPEC-master 5; master-A.json and master-B.json money.after).

combo.title: MoneyCombo
combo.description: A money path written price|before|after, such as list|card|counter (SPEC-master 5; lib.js parsePath line 347). Whether it is one of its flow's paths (the flow's money.combos; lib.js validCombo) is a code check.

varyKey.title: VaryKey
varyKey.description: A vary key: one or more parts joined by +, each a money choice (price:, before:, after:), a booking value (booking:) or a plug-in switch (pf:), such as before:deposit+after:card or pf:sensitive (SPEC-master 5 item 1, 5b, 5e; overlay-core.js lines 27 to 34).

stringList.title: StringList
stringList.description: A list of plain strings, kept as the master writes them: more lines, needs and gives keys, labels (SPEC-master 4; master-A.json and master-B.json; engine/work/prof/<id>.json).

items.description: One string of the list, kept as written (SPEC-master 4; master-A.json and master-B.json; engine/work/prof/<id>.json).

pair.title: Pair
pair.description: Two strings: a screen row (label, value), a rename pair or a swap pair (from, to) (SPEC-master 5f 'swap'; SPEC-prof 3 'rename'; a step's 'form').

items.description: One of the pair's two strings: the label or value of a screen row, or the from or to of a rename or swap pair (SPEC-master 5f 'swap'; SPEC-prof 3 'rename' and 'Screens').

table.title: Table
table.description: A screen or chat list with a header row and rows of cells (SPEC-master 4, chat element 'list'; SPEC-prof 3 'Screens': a step's 'table').

head.description: The header cells (a step's table.head; SPEC-prof 3 'Screens').

rows.description: The rows, each a list of cells (a step's table.rows; SPEC-prof 3 'Screens').

items.description: One row of cells (a step's table.rows[]; SPEC-prof 3 'Screens').

elements.title: MessageElements
elements.description: A message's chat elements (SPEC-master 4: 'Messages are chat elements (PLAIN-WORDS.md section 3): buttons, times, list, card, pay, code, photos, form, stars, stop'). The keys are the ones the master and the 243 trade files use (counted by T-008); the shape of the less used ones is kept as the master writes it.

card.description: A card with a title and lines (SPEC-master 4 example: { "card": { "title": ..., "lines": [...] } }).

button.description: The card's button label, such as 'Read and sign' (master-A.json S1-10 and S1-77 cards).

link.description: The card's link, a sample address such as rosfield.com/v/s03 (master-A.json S1-10 and S1-77 cards). An illustration; live links are slots (K-03; MC C6).

buttons.description: The buttons, numbered like the split's branch labels so a tap jumps to that branch (SPEC-master 4: '"1 Accept" is button 1'). A label whose whole text is a guard keyword fails the lint (arch 12 line 592; Q-14).

stop.description: The stop marker: true renders S13-02's full opt-out line on this message; "first" shows it only on the first text a number gets (SPEC-master 5j). Where the line goes now: Q-30's default (Rosie's first reply in a chat the person opened).

as.description: The one named person on a shared lane this message is for, such as Kim (SPEC-master 4 'as'). An illustration, never a live value (MC C6).

times.description: The times offered, one line each, such as 'Sat Oct 24 · 11:00am · Riley' (SPEC-master 4 'times'). Illustrations (MC C6).

photoLink.description: A photo-link element some trade files use (engine/work/prof, counted by T-008), kept as written.

form.description: The form's field names, such as 'Service', 'Price kind' (SPEC-master 4 'form').

code.description: A code, such as a check-in code (SPEC-master 4 'code'). An illustration; the live code is a slot (MC C6).

amount.description: The amount, usually a slot such as {{due:$125}} (master-A.json pay elements; SPEC-master 5h).

what.description: What it pays for (master-A.json pay elements).

link.description: A sample pay link (master-A.json pay elements). An illustration; the live pay link is a slot (K-03; MC C6).

lang.description: The message's language when it is not English, such as es (master-A.json, two messages).

en.description: The English words of a message written in another language (master-A.json, two messages).

button.title: Button
button.description: One button: its label, or a lettered pair such as ["C", "Neither works"] (SPEC-master 4 'buttons'; master-A.json A6-11; S13-12's lettered 'which?').

guardKeyword.title: GuardKeyword
guardKeyword.description: A guard keyword: START, HELP or one of msgtext.js's 16 opt-out words (arch 02 line 115: 'Code alone acts on a text that is only START, HELP or one of msgtext.js's 16 opt-out words'; msgtext.js OPTOUT, line 29).

keywordText.title: KeywordText
keywordText.description: A text that is only a guard keyword, trimmed, in any case (arch 02 line 115; msgtext.js line 95 compares String(label).trim().toUpperCase() with the list). The words: START, HELP, STOP, STOPALL, CANCEL, END, QUIT, UNSUBSCRIBE, REVOKE, OPTOUT, OPT OUT, CANCELAR, PARA, PARAR, ALTO, BASTA, DETENER, FIN.

keywordButton.title: KeywordButton
keywordButton.description: A button whose whole label is a guard keyword, such as S1-37's 'Start', which the guard would read as START (arch 12 line 592; Q-14). A lettered pair's key is one letter or digit, so only its label can match (msgtext.js line 91).

messagesWithKeywordButton.title: MessagesWithKeywordButton
messagesWithKeywordButton.description: Messages of which at least one carries a guard-keyword button (arch 12 line 592: 'a button's whole text is a guard keyword'). Used only by the step's lint checks.

contains.description: A message that carries a guard-keyword button (arch 12 line 592; SPEC-master 4 'buttons').

buttons.description: Its buttons, one of which is a guard keyword (arch 12 line 592; msgtext.js line 95).

messagesWithUnknownSlot.title: MessagesWithUnknownSlot
messagesWithUnknownSlot.description: Messages of which at least one names a slot outside the bundle's slot list (02-contracts K-01, refused fixture 'refuse-unknown-slot'; overlay-core.js slotProblems line 1508: 'no slot ...'). The list: overlay-core.js SLOTS (line 1285: alex.staff, name.staff, svc.intext, arrive, window, cutoff, day, keep, price, fee, deposit, rest, hold, paid), the ledger amounts (overlay-core.js LEDGER_AMOUNTS line 597 and AMOUNT_RE line 983: paidnow, due, back, later, backlate, name) and the record's 16 named slots (master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots). Used only by the step's lint checks.

contains.description: A message whose words name an unknown slot (02-contracts K-01; overlay-core.js line 1508).

text.description: Its words, holding '{{' and a name outside the slot list (overlay-core.js SLOT_RE line 1284).

chatList.title: ChatList
chatList.description: A chat list (SPEC-master 4 'list'): rows of cells, with or without a header row.

head.description: The header cells, when it has them (master-A.json list elements).

rows.description: The rows, each a list of cells (master-A.json list elements).

items.description: One row of cells (master-A.json list elements' rows[]; SPEC-master 4 'list').

plain.description: true: shown as plain text lines (master-A.json list elements).

pick.description: A pick marker some trade files use (engine/work/prof daycare.json, counted by T-008), kept as written.

numbers.description: A numbering marker some trade files use (engine/work/prof towing.json, counted by T-008), kept as written.

message.title: Message
message.description: One message line. The master writes it [from, to, text, elements] (SPEC-master 4 'say'); the bundle writes it as an object, since a tuple schema (prefixItems) gives a wider generated type (ADR-005), and adds its plain-text form (02-contracts K-01; msgtext.js smsText(); C-064).

from.description: Who sends it: the message's first item (SPEC-master 4).

to.description: Who gets it: the message's second item (SPEC-master 4).

text.description: The words, the message's third item, with slots such as {{svc.intext:Skin fade}} left in (SPEC-master 4, 5h). The sample names, dates, times, prices and places in it are illustrations that become slots (arch 12 line 592; MC C6).

elements.description: The chat elements, the message's fourth item when it has one (SPEC-master 4).

plainText.description: The message as plain text, its elements turned into text (msgtext.js smsText(); C-064 element text forms; MC 1 'a message as plain SMS'). Slots stay in.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: A step's or branch's 'when': which paths light it (SPEC-master 5 item 2, 5d, 5e, 5i; overlay-core.js lines 14 to 25). Each list means any of its values; every key present must hold.

booking.description: Lit for these booking values, any of them per group (SPEC-master 5e).

pf.description: Lit when the trade lists any of these facts; a trade with no facts list sees it (SPEC-master 5d, 'pf' is the same as 'factOn').

factOff.description: Lit when the trade lists none of these facts (SPEC-master 5d).

switchOn.description: Lit when any of these switches is on; a switch with no plug-in value is off (SPEC-master 5d).

switchOff.description: Lit when none of these switches is on (SPEC-master 5d).

rec.description: A record gate: lit when the booking holds any of these record values, such as credit, card, paid or keep (arch 03 line 161: 'a record gate when the booking holds the value'; master-A.json and master-B.json record; overlay-core.js line 437).

recOff.description: Lit when the booking holds none of these record values (master-A.json and master-B.json record slot rows; overlay-core.js line 437).

took.description: The stamp that this gate reads what the booking took, from the money step on: the flow letter (lib.js stampFlow line 900; overlay-core.js line 437).

ev.description: The stamp that this gate reads the event groups (charge, contact): the flow letter (overlay-core.js lines 167, 326 and 437).

wr.description: false: this gate's record values are read without what was written later (overlay-core.js lines 437 and 1765).

bookingValues.title: BookingValues
bookingValues.description: A booking's choices by group, each made once per booking and read later like money (SPEC-master 5e; overlay-core.js BOOKING lines 225 to 244 and EVENT_GROUPS lines 320 to 325). A group left out has its first value. Only live values: the record's live.off cuts reach notsafe, times noperson and line, and approval expert (master-A.json and master-B.json record.live.off; SPEC-master FIX7 amendments: notsafe dormant since D75).

timing.description: settime (a set time) or sentnow (sent now) (overlay-core.js BOOKING.timing).

times.description: How the times read: window, setstart, stay or seat (overlay-core.js BOOKING.times; noperson and line cut by record.live.off).

reach.description: How the customer is reached: texts, callsonly, textsonly or email (overlay-core.js BOOKING.reach; notsafe cut by record.live.off and D75). Calls only is not offered at launch (MC C2).

paidby.description: money (as its money choice says) or credit (paid by a credit) (overlay-core.js BOOKING.paidby).

privacy.description: open or private (a private booking) (overlay-core.js BOOKING.privacy; arch 03 line 175).

taken.description: asked (as the service asks) or nothing (nothing taken) (overlay-core.js BOOKING.taken).

approval.description: now (booked now) or ownerok (the owner's OK first) (overlay-core.js BOOKING.approval; expert cut by record.live.off).

madeby.description: customer, or shop (the business booked it for its own customer) (overlay-core.js BOOKING.madeby).

charge.description: An event group: none, later (a charge after booking went through) or failed (overlay-core.js EVENT_GROUPS.charge).

contact.description: An event group: kept, switched (updates go to a new phone or email) or stopped (texts stopped by STOP) (overlay-core.js EVENT_GROUPS.contact).

payer.description: A record group: self or other (someone else pays) (overlay-core.js EVENT_GROUPS.payer).

sets.title: Sets
sets.description: A branch's 'sets': a booking value that changes mid-booking, read by its own steps and, once it rejoins, by every step after its split (SPEC-master 5e, the sets paragraph; master values such as {"privacy":"private"}, {"payer":"other"}, {"svcAdd":"a-add"}).

svcAdd.description: A service added to the booking, by its record service id, such as a-add (master-A.json, a branch's sets {"svcAdd":"a-add"}; the record's services).

path.title: Path
path.description: The path model: which branches are lit and which words a step shows for one booking (02-contracts K-01 'The path model'; overlay-core.js lines 6 to 12: { price, before, after, booking, pf, facts }; lib.js parsePath line 338, whose text form is 'list|card|bill +switched booking=reach:callsonly,privacy:private pf=grief facts=packs'). Parity is checked against these functions with each trade's full switches and facts (Q-35).

flow.description: The flow the path runs in (lib.js parsePath: 'the flow must be A or B').

booking.description: The booking values (overlay-core.js line 8: 'a group left out has its first value').

switches.description: The plug-in switches, by name; missing means off (overlay-core.js line 10, 'pf'; SPEC-master 5b).

additionalProperties.description: true: the switch is on for this path; a switch left out is off (overlay-core.js line 10, 'pf'; SPEC-master 5b).

facts.description: The plug-in facts the trade lists, or null when it lists none (then every fact-gated branch shows) (overlay-core.js lines 11 and 12; SPEC-master 5d).

services.description: The booking's services when it has more than one, by record service id (02-contracts K-01 path model 'services'; lib.js fixturePaths, the path's 'svc'; the record's services).

fixture.description: The record fixture the path rides, such as two-card, when it names one (lib.js parsePath line 348, '+<fixture id>'; master-A.json and master-B.json record.fixtures).

wordsPatch.title: WordsPatch
wordsPatch.description: Other words for some paths: a vary entry (SPEC-master 5 item 1: 'A variant may change only does, more, say, rule, t, form and table (never the title, ids or keys)'; 5f: swap, addMore, addSay; overlay-core.js line 34). In one variant: swap first, then the fields it sets, then the adds (5f).

does.description: What the step does, in one or two sentences (SPEC-master 4 'does').

more.description: Detail lines, one rule per line; a variant that sets its own more replaces the whole base more (SPEC-master 4, 5k).

t.description: When it happens, in the sample story, possibly relative to another step (SPEC-master 4 't', 5g). An illustration (MC C6).

form.description: A screen as label and value pairs (SPEC-prof 3 'Screens').

swap.description: Find-and-replace pairs on the words shown so far, whole words (SPEC-master 5f).

addMore.description: Lines added after the more lines under it (SPEC-master 5f).

addSay.description: Messages added after the messages under it (SPEC-master 5f).

vary.title: Vary
vary.description: A step's other words by path: vary key to words. The most specific choice key that fits wins; switch and booking keys are laid over it field by field, least specific first (SPEC-master 5 item 1, 5b, 5e; overlay-core.js lines 27 to 34).

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: When the step's question times out: its own Clock line, or step 9's default (arch 03 line 181; arch 12 line 592: 'only 13 of 210 decisions state a Clock line; the rest take step 9's default'; arch 02 line 127).

from.description: clockLine: the step states one; step9Default: arch 02 line 127's default applies (7pm the day before the visit, 2 hours before a same-day visit, at least 1 hour after delivery; 8pm the day after delivery with no visit).

text.description: The Clock line's words, word for word, when from is clockLine (arch 12 line 592).

card.title: StepCard
card.description: The step card the model is given for an open question or a hub: question, each branch's Means line, Never lines, safe default and Clock (arch 03 line 181: 'full step cards (question, Means, Never, safe default)'; arch 12 line 592; 02-contracts K-01). A card with neither a safe default nor a clock, or with a branch that has no definition, fails the lint: its step's lint lists the rule (arch 12 line 592).

means.description: One definition per branch (arch 12 line 592: '48 lack a Means line; the first sentence of the step it leads to stands in').

items.description: One branch's definition: its Means line, or the first sentence of the step it leads to standing in (arch 12 line 592; 02-contracts K-01).

branch.description: The branch label, word for word (SPEC-master 4; SPEC-master 5d: 'never rename a branch label').

text.description: The definition (arch 12 line 592). Left out when from is none.

from.description: meansLine: the step's own "Means '...'" line; firstSentence: the first sentence of the step the branch leads to (arch 12 line 592: '48 lack a Means line; the first sentence of the step it leads to stands in'); none: neither exists, so the choice has no definition and its step fails the lint rule choice-without-definition (arch 12 line 592).

never.description: The step's Never lines, word for word (arch 03 line 181; the step's more lines that start 'Never').

safeDefault.description: What the step does when nobody answers in time; a step without one changes nothing, charges nobody, moves nobody (arch 01 line 81; arch 03 line 181).

clock.description: The question's Clock: its own Clock line, or step 9's default (arch 12 line 592: 'only 13 of 210 decisions state a Clock line; the rest take step 9's default'). Left out, with no safeDefault either, the step fails the lint rule no-safe-default-or-clock.

answerField.title: AnswerField
answerField.description: A field a branch's answer carries, with its type, taken from the gives keys and record values (02-contracts K-01 'the fields its answer carries and their types'; ops/plan/02-contracts.md section 8 names each key's contract field). The model gives each with its source words and code re-parses it (arch 03 line 185).

name.description: The field's name: a gives key such as time_saved, or a record value (SPEC-master 4 'gives'; master-A.json and master-B.json record).

type.description: Its value type: text, integer or boolean; money, time, zone or id as the shared formats write them (contracts/common/formats.v1.schema.json, CQ-09); choice, one of the open question's option ids (arch 03 line 183).

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: One write, message, charge, refund or clock a choice causes; code runs it and the model never names it (arch 01 line 77; 02-contracts K-01: 'record writes, messages and to whom, clocks, charges, refunds, calendar writes and flags').

kind.description: What it does (02-contracts K-01, the branch's effects).

ref.description: What it acts on: the gives key or record field written, the step whose message goes, the Clock line armed, the record amount charged or refunded (02-contracts K-01; SPEC-master 4 'gives', 'tells'; master-A.json and master-B.json record).

to.description: For a message: who gets it (SPEC-master 4 'tells').

flag.description: For a flag: the record flag set, checked by the gate, the dispatcher, the charge job, clock firings and the crew day list (arch 03 line 175: deceased, stopped, private, paused).

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: One branch of a split (SPEC-master 4, 'A split ... branches'), compiled: its steps by id, its tag and its end.

label.description: The label, word for word; overlays turn a branch off by it (SPEC-master 4 'label'; 5d).

tag.description: message: the model may choose it; lookup: code settles it; clock: a clock row settles it. Only message branches enter the choices (arch 03 line 161).

when.description: The paths that light it (SPEC-master 5 item 2, 5d, 5e).

steps.description: The branch's own steps, in order, by id; each is in the flow's steps (SPEC-master 4 'steps').

end.description: merge: rejoins the path after the split; end: this path stops (SPEC-master 4 'end'). Left out where the master leaves it out.

endText.description: The text an ending branch ends with (SPEC-master 4 'endText').

flow.description: An ending branch that continues in the other flow: that flow (SPEC-master 4: '"flow": "B" on an ending branch').

rejoinAt.description: Where the walk goes after a merging branch: the step after its split, or null when the walk ends or leaves the flow, or when the split is the last step of its own list, where the enclosing branch's rejoinAt decides, as for next (02-contracts K-01 'its end (rejoins, ends with its text, or continues in the other flow)'; arch 03 line 191).

answerFields.description: The fields its answer carries (02-contracts K-01).

effects.description: Its effects, run by code once (arch 01 line 77; 02-contracts K-01).

reads.description: For a lookup branch: the field code reads to settle it (arch 03 line 161: 'code settles lookups'; arch 12 line 592: 'a lookup lacks the field it reads'). Q-39's default: the lint fails a lookup whose needs key or record field has no source on some path. A lookup branch without reads fails the lint rule lookup-without-field.

from.description: needs: a key an earlier step gives (SPEC-master 4 'needs'); record: a record value (master-A.json and master-B.json record; arch 03 line 161: 'a record gate when the booking holds the value'); path: a value of the path model, a money or booking choice, a switch or a fact (overlay-core.js lines 6 to 12; SPEC-master 5, 5d, 5e).

key.description: The key, such as card_saved, credit or before (SPEC-master 4 'needs' and 5's keys; master-A.json and master-B.json record; overlay-core.js line 7).

pluginSlot.title: PluginSlot
pluginSlot.description: The plug-in slot node (S1-11): one node that fills every pf key for a kind of work (SPEC-master 8, section 1: 'slot: { fills, reads, gives, examples }'; master-A.json S1-11).

fills.description: What the slot fills, in plain words (SPEC-master 8).

reads.description: The keys it reads, such as kinds (SPEC-master 8).

gives.description: The pf keys it gives (SPEC-master 4: 'The slot is S1-xx in section 1 and gives every pf key').

examples.description: Its examples, kept as the master writes them; never renamed (SPEC-master 5h, the last line).

step.title: Step
step.description: One step of a flow, compiled (SPEC-master 4; 02-contracts K-01 'each step (id, section, who, to, via, title, needs, gives, tells) with its card'). Authoring fields are left out (MC R2: src, prop). A step that fails a lint rule says so in lint, and the schema refuses a step that shows a failure its lint does not list (arch 12 line 592; T-010).

section.description: Its section, 1 to 13, in the order of engine/design/LINES.md (master-A.json and master-B.json 'sec'; SPEC-master 1).

kind.description: rule: a section 13 node, a rule every step follows, not a step in time (SPEC-master 4 'kind'). These are the always-on rules (arch 03 line 181).

to.description: Who it is for, when someone is (SPEC-master 4 'to').

as.description: The one named person on a shared lane (SPEC-master 4 'as'). An illustration (MC C6).

t.description: When it happens in the sample story (SPEC-master 4 't', 5g). An illustration (MC C6).

more.description: Detail lines, one rule per line, holding the Means, Never and Silence lines and 'judgment rule N' pointers (SPEC-master 4 'more', 5k). Every 'judgment rule N' must resolve to rule 1 to 67 (MC R6).

form.description: A screen as label and value pairs (SPEC-prof 3 'Screens').

needs.description: The keys it uses; it may only need what an earlier step gave on every path to it (SPEC-master 4 'needs'; BP 3.5: runtime data, not build edges).

gives.description: The keys it gives (SPEC-master 4 'gives'; 02-contracts section 8 names each key's contract field).

tells.description: Who gets a message in this step (SPEC-master 4 'tells').

reads.description: The record homes it reads, such as stop or contact (master-A.json and master-B.json steps[].reads; the names of the routing tables' homes, master-A.json and master-B.json record.homes; 02-contracts K-01).

when.description: The step's own gate: where it fails the step and its branches are skipped (SPEC-master 5d, 5i).

text.description: The step id the source part names in its 'text' field, kept as written (master-A.json and master-B.json; the source parts A36.json and B36.json, where a flow B step names its flow A twin).

visit.description: The visit's day and time in the sample story, where the master states one on the step (master-A.json and master-B.json 'visit'). An illustration (MC C6).

tradeSettings.description: A trade's sign-up settings for one flow, typed (SPEC-prof 3 'Sign-up settings'; MC R3: code reads pf.settings by name; MC C5: a trade with none starts with arrive window and an empty free-cancel time, which the owner confirms at sign-up).

arrive.description: window (the default), setstart, or { window: hours } (SPEC-prof 3; SPEC-master 5h {{arrive}}).

cutoff.description: The free-cancel time, such as '24 hours before' or '7am the day of', or null when empty (SPEC-prof 3; SPEC-master 5h {{cutoff}}; MC C5).

tradeMoney.title: TradeMoney
tradeMoney.description: A trade's money for one flow: its main path, the paths it uses with an example each, its amounts, services, booking values and labels (SPEC-prof 3 'money'; the trade file's money.<flow>; overlay-core.js apply() lines 1808 to 1814).

combos.description: The paths the trade really uses (money.<flow>.combos; SPEC-prof D66 amendment: only the master's 28).

examples.description: One plain line per path (money.<flow>.examples). Illustrations (MC C6).

additionalProperties.description: One path's plain line (engine/work/prof/<id>.json money.<flow>.examples.<combo>). An illustration (MC C6).

amounts.description: The trade's own amount rows, which replace the master's example rows for this flow (money.<flow>.amounts; overlay-core.js line 1810). Illustrations (MC C6).

services.description: The trade's own services, joined to the record's (money.<flow>.services; overlay-core.js line 1802).

booking.description: The booking values the trade uses, by group; a group left out offers every value (money.<flow>.booking; SPEC-master 5e; SPEC-prof 3 'Booking choices').

additionalProperties.description: The values the trade uses in one booking group (engine/work/prof/<id>.json money.<flow>.booking.<group>; SPEC-master 5e).

labels.description: The trade's own labels for money choices, by question and value (money.<flow>.labels; overlay-core.js line 1808).

propertyNames.description: A money question: price, before or after (engine/work/prof/<id>.json money.<flow>.labels; overlay-core.js line 1808).

additionalProperties.description: One money question's labels by value (engine/work/prof/<id>.json money.<flow>.labels.<question>; overlay-core.js line 1808).
The trade's label for one value (engine/work/prof/<id>.json money.<flow>.labels.<question>.<value>; overlay-core.js line 1808).

overlayOp.title: OverlayOp
overlayOp.description: One overlay op, in the trade file's order (SPEC-prof 3 'ops'; overlay-core.js apply() lines 1815 to 1856). Compiled: added steps are compiled steps; fields overlay-core ignores are left out; C8's void offs are dropped (MC C8: offs of S1-32, S2-22, S11-48, S11-57 citing D96 in 12 trades, and of S11-50, S13-11, S13-15, S2-11 in the trades it names); every other off stays.

op.description: off: a master step, or one branch by its label, this trade never uses (SPEC-prof 3; overlay-core.js line 1848).

label.description: The branch label, matched exactly (SPEC-prof 3; SPEC-master 5d).

op.description: words: the trade's own words for a master step, field by field (SPEC-prof 3; overlay-core.js line 1822).

title.description: A new title (SPEC-prof 3: a words op may set the title, since Oct 25).

vary.description: The trade's words for some paths, merged field by field into the master's variant of the same key (SPEC-prof 3; overlay-core.js line 1825).

op.description: more: extra detail lines, added to the base and every variant that sets more (SPEC-prof 3; overlay-core.js line 1827).
after or before: the trade's own steps, inserted after or before a master step (SPEC-prof 3; overlay-core.js line 1831).

first.description: The first inserted main-path step; the rest follow by next, and the last one's next is the step that followed in the master (overlay-core.js line 1838).

steps.description: Every step the op adds, branch steps included, compiled (SPEC-prof 3: 'Same step format as the master').

op.description: branch: a new branch on a master decision (SPEC-prof 3; overlay-core.js line 1841).

at.description: The master split (overlay-core.js line 1842: it must be a decision).

tradeFlow.title: TradeFlow
tradeFlow.description: What one trade changes in one flow (SPEC-prof 3; 02-contracts K-01 'One compiled overlay per trade').

switches.description: The switches on in this flow, resolved from pf.switches (a per-flow value { A, B } split per flow), with no2 derived from the trade's choice at the $2 split S1-62 (SPEC-master 5j; SPEC-prof 3 'No $2'; MC R3). Every switch left out is off (SPEC-master 5b).

additionalProperties.description: true: the switch is on in this flow for this trade (engine/work/prof/<id>.json pf.switches; SPEC-prof 3; SPEC-master 5b).

rename.description: The trade's rename pairs for this flow, in order, longer phrases first (SPEC-prof 3 'rename'; overlay-core.js line 1800). Their right sides are illustrations (MC C6).

slotRows.description: The trade's own record slot rows for this flow, laid before the master's, slot by slot (the trade file's slots.<flow>; overlay-core.js profRecord line 1867). Empty when it has none.

ops.description: The trade's ops for this flow, in order (SPEC-prof 3 'ops').

tradeOverlay.title: TradeOverlay
tradeOverlay.description: One KV value: one trade's compiled overlay (Q-34 default; 02-contracts K-01: facts, switches and settings as typed values with C5's fills, the 11 free-text pf blocks stored whole, money per flow, steps and branches turned off with C8's void list applied, words per path, added steps and branches, renames, and the trade's own slot rows; SPEC-prof 3 and 8; overlay-core.js apply(), lines 1794 to 1866). Authoring fields are left out (MC R2: notes, basis, keep, from, splitsKept, keep_why), as are the sample cast, names and story (MC C6). Stored under kvKey .../trade/<id> (arch 10 line 536).

trade.description: Who the trade is (SPEC-prof 3: id, name, style, pattern).

facts.description: The facts the trade lists, or null when it lists none (SPEC-prof 3 'Plug-in facts'; MC R3). C5's fill applies: insurance lists video, forms, firststeps and documents.

flows.description: What the trade changes in each flow; every trade writes both (SPEC-prof 1: 'Write BOTH flows in full').

kvKey.title: KvKey
kvKey.description: A KV key of one bundle value: bundle/<hash>/<build>/manifest, bundle/<hash>/<build>/flow/<A or B> or bundle/<hash>/<build>/trade/<trade id> (02-contracts K-01 'Storage: the KV keys per bundle id (manifest, flow graphs, trade overlays)'; T-008 default spelling). At most 512 bytes, Cloudflare KV's key size limit (developers.cloudflare.com/kv/platform/limits, read 2026-11-07).

storedValue.title: StoredValue
storedValue.description: One KV value of the bundle besides the manifest: its key, what it holds, its size and its hash. The same bytes are also written under the same key to K-04's bundle copy in PostgreSQL, which the actor reads on a KV miss (arch 10 line 536; 02-contracts K-01 'Storage').

kind.description: flow: a flowGraph; trade: a tradeOverlay (02-contracts K-01 'Storage').

flow.description: For kind flow: which flow (02-contracts K-01).

trade.description: For kind trade: which trade (02-contracts K-01).

bytes.description: The value's size in bytes, as stored (UTF-8 JSON). At most 25 MiB (26,214,400 bytes), Cloudflare KV's value size limit on the Free and Paid plans (developers.cloudflare.com/kv/platform/limits, read 2026-11-07; Q-34's spike, contracts/bundle/README.md).

sha256.description: The sha256 of the value's stored bytes (Q-36's hash; the bundle id's hash is built from these).

inputFile.title: InputFile
inputFile.description: One input of the build, with its hash (02-contracts K-01 'the hashes of every input (master-A.json, master-B.json, the 243 trade files, the Master Corrections version, engine/design/LINES.md, the overlays Jay approved, and fixture set v1's manifest, Q-36)').

kind.description: masterFlow: master-A.json or master-B.json; trade: a trade file; masterCorrections: '3 Master Corrections.md'; lines: engine/design/LINES.md; approvedOverlay: an overlay Jay approved (arch 12 line 592: 'fixes go in an overlay Jay approves'); fixtureSetManifest: fixtures/v1/MANIFEST.sha256 (Q-36); referenceCode: overlay-core.js, lib.js or msgtext.js, the functions parity runs against (MC 1; Q-35).

path.description: Its path: the master's own path for a master file, such as engine/work/master/master-A.json (MC 1, the path rule), or the repository path, such as fixtures/v1/MANIFEST.sha256 (Q-36).

trade.description: For kind trade: the trade id (MC 1).

version.description: For kind masterCorrections or approvedOverlay: its version or approval date as written (02-contracts K-01 'the Master Corrections version').

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: The guard's keyword list, which the guard (C-051), the lint (C-065 to C-070) and the message checks (C-092) all read (02-contracts K-01 'Shared lists'; arch 02 line 115). A text that is only one of these words, trimmed and in any case, is acted on by code alone.

start.description: START: turns texts back on (arch 02 line 115; RULES 7.5).

help.description: HELP: gets the business's name and number and how to stop (arch 02 line 115; S13-32; RULES 7.6).

optOut.description: msgtext.js's 16 opt-out words, as written there (msgtext.js OPTOUT, line 29; arch 02 line 115): STOP, STOPALL, CANCEL, END, QUIT, UNSUBSCRIBE, REVOKE, OPTOUT, OPT OUT, CANCELAR, PARA, PARAR, ALTO, BASTA, DETENER, FIN.

flagsVisit.description: The opt-out words that also flag the visit: CANCEL and CANCELAR (arch 02 line 115: 'CANCEL or CANCELAR also flags the visit'; RULES 7.4; S13-28 rule 46).

items.description: One word that also flags the visit (arch 02 line 115).

fixedLine.title: FixedLine
fixedLine.description: One fixed line: added by code, word for word as its source writes it, outside the composer's Shape and Length counts (arch 07 line 361; BP rule 3; C-089 fixed-line inserter).

id.description: The line's name, such as optOutLine or stopLaterReply (02-contracts K-01 'Shared lists': the fixed lines).

text.description: The words, exactly as the source writes them; <business> is the one placeholder, filled with the business's name (arch 07 line 361). null while the words wait for Jay (Q-01: the stop replies' drafted words go to Jay on a tier 3 card before any release).

lang.description: The line's language, as a two-letter code such as en (arch 07 line 361: 'in section 06's language'; arch 06: safety lines in each checked language).

status.description: asWritten: the source's own words, used as they are; pendingJay: no final words yet, so text is null and the line waits for Jay (Q-01 default).

use.description: Where code adds it, in plain words (arch 07 line 361; the source named in source).

source.description: Where the words come from: a RULES section, a step id, an architecture line or a question row (02-contracts section 2 item 4).

status.description: asWritten: the source's own words (arch 07 line 361).

text.description: A line used as written has its words (arch 07 line 361; BP rule 3).
A line that waits for Jay has none yet (Q-01).

fixedLines.title: FixedLines
fixedLines.description: The fixed lines word for word (02-contracts K-01 'Shared lists'; arch 07 line 361; BP rule 3): the guard's START, HELP and STOP replies in C1's every-business meaning (words per Q-01), the safety lines, step 7's last line (arch 02 line 123), the outage line (arch 11 lines 564 and 566), the opener and the opt-out line. That every id is there once is a contract-test check.

keyMapEntry.title: KeyMapEntry
keyMapEntry.description: How one top key of a trade file reaches the compiled overlay (arch 12 line 592: 'map the 2,344 plug-in keys, or mark them guidance only'; MC R3: trade files are read by top key only; Q-39 default).

key.description: The trade file's top key, such as pf.facts, pf.services or money (SPEC-prof 3; MC R3).

as.description: typed: code reads it by name into a typed field (MC R3: pf.facts, pf.switches, pf.settings, money.<flow>); textBlock: stored whole as one text block for the AI, its sub-keys guidance only (MC R3; Q-39 default; FRONTEND-SPEC.md line 565); ops: compiled into the overlay's ops, renames or slot rows (SPEC-prof 3); leftOut: authoring fields (MC R2) or the sample cast and story (MC C6).

to.description: Where it lands in a tradeOverlay, as a path such as pluginText/pf.license or flows/<flow>/settings; left out for leftOut (SPEC-prof 3; this schema's $defs/tradeOverlay).

why.description: Its source (MC R2, R3, C6; SPEC-prof 3; Q-39).

as.description: leftOut: authoring fields or the sample cast and story (MC R2, C6).

keyMap.title: KeyMap
keyMap.description: The plug-in key map: each trade-file top key and where it goes (02-contracts K-01 'Shared lists'; arch 12 line 592; Q-39 default: the 11 free-text pf keys are mapped as whole text blocks, their sub-keys guidance only; MC R3).

keys.description: One entry per top key (MC R3: 'Read trade files by top key only').

subKeys.description: guidance: no sub-key under a textBlock key is read by code; it is guidance in the text the AI is given (Q-39 default; MC R3: 'sub-keys differ from file to file').

outOfScopeTarget.title: OutOfScopeTarget
outOfScopeTarget.description: One thing an out-of-scope marker makes unreachable (01-inventory.md group 11; C-149 unreachability tests).

at.description: The step (01-inventory.md group 11 rows name each step).

unreachable.description: step: the whole step; branch: one branch of it, by label; line: one line of it, word for word; firstText: any text Rosie would send first on that step or branch, to someone who has not texted Rosie (MC C9: 'Rosie never writes first, by iMessage or SMS').

branch.description: The branch label, word for word (SPEC-master 5d: overlays match labels exactly).

line.description: The line, word for word as the master writes it: a say text or a more line (master-A.json and master-B.json; 01-inventory.md group 11).

unreachable.description: branch: one branch, named by label (01-inventory.md group 11).
line: one line, word for word (01-inventory.md group 11).

outOfScopeMarker.title: OutOfScopeMarker
outOfScopeMarker.description: An out-of-scope marker: one 01-inventory.md group 11 row, C-222 to C-254, with what it makes unreachable, so C-149's unreachability tests check each one (02-contracts K-01 'Shared lists' and 'Contract test').

component.description: The group 11 component id, C-222 to C-254 (01-inventory.md group 11).

title.description: What is out, in the inventory's words (01-inventory.md group 11).

why.description: Its source: a Master Corrections item, a decision or a question row (01-inventory.md group 11).

outOfScope.title: OutOfScope
outOfScope.description: The out-of-scope markers each unreachability test checks (02-contracts K-01 'Shared lists'; 01-inventory.md group 11, C-222 to C-254). That every group 11 id has a marker is a contract-test check.

sharedLists.title: SharedLists
sharedLists.description: The shared lists, so the guard, the lint and the message checks read one list (02-contracts K-01 'Shared lists'): the keywords, the fixed lines, the plug-in key map and the out-of-scope markers. They ride in the manifest, which a turn reads first (arch 10 line 536).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: One prompt a turn runs on, shipped inside the bundle (arch 01 line 87; K-03: 'The prompt texts themselves are the AI engineer's (C-119) and ship inside the bundle').

version.description: The prompt's own version, as its owner names it (C-119; 02-contracts K-01 'the prompts').

sha256.description: The sha256 of text's UTF-8 bytes (Q-36's hash).

modelRole.title: ModelRole
modelRole.description: Which of the bundle's two models: haiku or sonnet (arch 11 line 564; arch 02 line 119).

readPair.title: ReadPair
readPair.description: The two reads that must agree on a turn: the first and the checking read (arch 02 line 119: 'Haiku twice with the choices shuffled, or, on high stakes, Sonnet with Haiku checking').

first.description: The model that reads first (arch 02 line 119; Q-26).

lintRule.title: LintRule
lintRule.description: A lint rule the compiler runs (C-065 to C-070): no-safe-default-or-clock, choice-without-definition, lookup-without-field, loop and guard-keyword-button are arch 12 line 592's five ('The lint fails a step when a question lacks a safe default or a clock, ... when a choice lacks a definition, when a lookup lacks the field it reads, when a walk can loop, or when a button's whole text is a guard keyword'); unknown-slot is a slot outside the bundle's slot list (02-contracts K-01); judgment-rule-out-of-range is a 'judgment rule N' outside 1 to 67 (MC R6); record-lint is the record's own lint tables (master-A.json and master-B.json record.lint). What the lookup and loop rules test: Q-39's default.

lintFailure.title: LintFailure
lintFailure.description: One step that fails a lint rule (arch 12 line 592: 'The lint fails a step when ...').

trade.description: The trade whose overlay fails, or null for the master itself (02-contracts K-01; arch 03 line 155: trade settings change 10 to 20% of a flow).

branch.description: The branch label, when one branch fails (SPEC-master 4).

message.description: What fails, in plain words (arch 12 line 592).

journeyGate.title: JourneyGate
journeyGate.description: Whether a journey may ship: 'A journey with a failing step does not ship; fixes go in an overlay Jay approves' (arch 12 line 592; Q-17).

journey.description: The journey number, 1 to 12 (ops/plan/02-contracts.md sections 9 and 10: journeys 1 to 12).

ships.description: true only when none of its steps fails the lint; a journey that ships lists no failing step (arch 12 line 592: 'A journey with a failing step does not ship'; Q-17).

failingSteps.description: Its failing steps, by id (arch 12 line 592).

ships.description: A journey that ships (arch 12 line 592; Q-17).

failingSteps.description: It has no failing step (arch 12 line 592: 'A journey with a failing step does not ship').

lintReport.title: LintReport
lintReport.description: The lint summary: each rule run with its count of failing steps, and every failing step (02-contracts K-01 'the lint summary'; arch 12 line 592).

rules.description: Each rule run, with its count of failing steps (arch 12 line 592).

items.description: One lint rule run and its count of failing steps (arch 12 line 592; 02-contracts K-01 'the lint summary').

failures.description: How many steps fail it (arch 12 line 592).

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.description: One KV value: the bundle's manifest, read first at turn start once the actor has the active bundle id from K-04's bundle registry (arch 10 line 536; 02-contracts K-01 'The manifest'). Stored under kvKey .../manifest.

bundleId.description: The bundle id: a content hash plus a build number (CQ-09; arch 01 line 87; tour line 658: every published bundle stays readable for replay). The hash, as this contract spells it (T-008 default): the sha256, in lowercase hex, of the UTF-8 text made of one line '<sha256>  <key after bundle/<hash>/<build>/>' per stored value, sorted by that key part, each line ending in a newline, so equal content gives an equal hash. The build number counts publishes from 1 (C-072).

hash.description: The content hash as this contract spells it: 64 lowercase hex characters (CQ-09; T-008 default, above).

build.description: The build number, counting publishes from 1 (CQ-09; C-072).

builtAt.description: When it was built, in UTC (02-contracts K-01 'when it was built'; CQ-09).

compiler.description: The compiler that built it (02-contracts K-01 'the compiler version'; C-058).

commit.description: The git commit the compiler was built from, when known (02-contracts K-01 'the compiler version').

inputs.description: Every input with its hash (02-contracts K-01). That the list is complete (2 flows, 243 trades, Master Corrections, LINES.md, fixture set v1's manifest) is a contract-test check.

prompts.description: The prompts one turn runs on: the safety read, decide, planner and composer (arch 01 line 87; 02-contracts K-01).

models.description: The model ids one turn runs on (arch 01 line 87; arch 11 line 564: claude-haiku-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5).

policy.description: Routing by stakes: which models read on low and high stakes, and which one does the turn's one re-read (arch 01 line 79: stakes; arch 02 line 119; arch 10 line 520; Q-26 default: Sonnet first on high stakes).

low.description: Low stakes: Haiku twice with the choices shuffled (arch 02 line 119).

high.description: High stakes: Sonnet with Haiku checking (arch 02 line 119; Q-26).

reread.description: The model of the one re-read per turn (arch 02 line 119: 'one Sonnet re-read per turn').

journeys.description: Which journeys may ship (02-contracts K-01; arch 12 line 592; Q-17).

storage.description: Where the bundle's values live (02-contracts K-01 'Storage'; arch 10 line 536). The active bundle id is not here: it sits in K-04's bundle registry, and the deploy publishes the bundle before it switches the active id (BP 5.4; C-020).

manifestKey.description: This manifest's own KV key (02-contracts K-01 'Storage').

values.description: Every other value: one per flow and one per trade (Q-34 default; 02-contracts K-01 'Storage').

partial.description: true: the bundle holds only some steps, as bundle v0 (S1-01 and S1-02, D-007) and the sample bundles do; its routing tables still name the master's step ids, and a step it does not hold is not reachable. Left out: it holds every step of each flow it carries (02-contracts K-01 'Fixtures').
